title: 48 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Inner Peace)
description:
Learn 48 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 48 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Inner Peace · Amani ya Ndani
1:24  Kindness · Wema
2:46  Motivation · Motisha
4:08  Gratitude · Shukrani
5:23  Coffee Shop & Bakery · Duka la Kahawa na Mkate
6:39  Mindfulness · Kujitambua

PHRASE LIST

INNER PEACE · Amani ya Ndani
• I breathe, and I soften inward. - Nina pumua, nami na laini ndani.  [Na-na PUMUA, na-mi na LAINI DANI.]
• My chest feels lighter right now. - Kifua changu kinaonekana kuwa chepesi sasa.  [KIFUA CHA-NGU ki-na-o-onekana KWA- wa CHEPESI SA-SA.]
• I make room for calm today. - Naweka nafasi kwa utulivu leo.  [Na-UNK-wa NAFASI kwa U-TU-LI-VU LEO.]
• I pause, then let thoughts pass. - Na simama kidogo, kisha mawazo yapite.  [Na SI-MA-ma KI-DOGO, kisha MA-A-zo YA-PITE.]
• I trust my next step. - Nawaamini hatua yangu inayofuata.  [Na-wa-A-MI-ni HATUA YA-NGU INAYO-FU-A-TA.]
• Even my silence feels safe. - Hata ukimya wangu unahisi salama.  [HA-ta U-KIMYA WA-ngu u-na-HISI SA-LA-ma.]

KINDNESS · Wema
• Speak gently, even when you're angry - Sema kwa upole, hata ukiwa na hasira  [SEMA kwa UPole, HATA ukiwa na haSIRA]
• Include people, don't leave them out - Wajumuishe watu, usiwaache nje  [WAJUMUISHE watu, USIwaache NJE]
• Notice pain, ask, and actually care - Uone maumivu, uliza, kisha kujali  [Uone MAUUMIVU, uLIza, kisha KUJALI]
• Bring water, tea, or a snack - Leta maji, chai, au kitu kidogo cha kula  [LETA MAJI, chai, au KItu kidogo cha KUla]
• Make space for quiet, not noise - Acha nafasi ya utulivu, si kelele  [Acha NAFASI ya uTULIVU, si keLELE]
• If you mess up, repair right away - Ukipotoka, rekebisha mara moja  [UkipoTOKA, REKEBISHA maRA MOJA]

MOTIVATION · Motisha
• I can handle the next small thing. - Naweza kushughulikia hatua inayofuata tu.  [NAWEza kushugHUHikia HAta inayofuAto TU.]
• My future needs my effort now. - Utu wangu wa baadaye unahitaji juhudi yangu sasa.  [uTU wangu wa baaDAye unaHITaji JUhudi yangu saSA.]
• Make it happen, then adjust. - Fanya iwezekane, kisha rekebisha.  [FANya iwezeKANE, KIsha reKEbiSha.]
• No drama, just steady action. - Bila maumivu ya moyo, fanya tu kwa uthabiti.  [BIla mauMIvu ya moyo, FANya tu kwa uTHAbaTi.]
• Even one minute is real progress. - Hata dakika moja ni maendeleo halisi.  [HATA DAKiKA MOja ni MAendeleo HAliSI.]
• Let doubt speak, I keep moving. - Wacha shaka izungumze, mimi naendelea.  [WAcha SHAka iZUNGumze, MI mi NAENdelea.]

GRATITUDE · Shukrani
• Thank you for checking in on me. - Asante kwa kunijulia hali.  [A-SAN-TE kwa ku-NI-ju-li-a ha-li.]
• I’m grateful for your encouragement today. - Na-shukuru kwa kuti-a moyo leo.  [Na-SHU-ku-RU kwa ku-TI-a MO-yo LEO.]
• Thank you for sharing that with me. - Asante kwa kunishirikisha hilo.  [A-SAN-TE kwa ku-NI-SHI-ri-KI-sha HI-lo.]
• You saved me a lot of trouble. - Ulininusua matatizo mengi.  [U-li-ni-nu-SUA ma-ta-ta-zo MEN-gi.]
• Thanks for making time for my family. - Asante kwa kutupangia muda sisi na familia yangu.  [A-SAN-TE kwa ku-tu-PAN-gia MU-da SI-si na FA-mi-li-a yangu.]
• I appreciate you being so dependable. - Na-shukuru kwa kuwa mwaminifu na thabiti.  [Na-SHU-ku-RU kwa ku-wa mWA-mi-ni-fu na tha-BI-ti.]

COFFEE SHOP & BAKERY · Duka la Kahawa na Mkate
• Hi, what s fresh from the oven? - Habari, ni kipi kipya kutoka kwenye oveni leo?  [Habari, ni kipi piya kutoka KWENYE ov-enI LEO?]
• Can I get a latte, please? - Naweza kupata latte tafadhali.  [Na-weza PA-ta la-tte ta-FAD-ha-li.]
• Do you have cinnamon buns today? - Mna mikate ya cinnamon leo?  [Mna mi-kate ya CIN-na-mon leO?]
• I ll take the croissant, lightly toasted. - Nitaichukua croissant, nikaitoe kidogo.  [Ni-ta-i-CHU-KUA croissant, ni-ka-itoe ki-DO-go.]
• What bread is good for sandwiches? - Mkate gani unafaa kwa sandwichi?  [M-kate gani u-na-fa-a kwa SAN-dwi-chi?]
• Is your coffee smooth or strong? - Kahawa yenu ni laini au kali?  [Ka-HA-wa ye-nu ni LAi-ni au KA-li?]

MINDFULNESS · Kujitambua
• Right now, soften your grip. - Sasa hivi, lEgesha ushikaman**o** wako.  [Sasa hivi, lEgesha ushikaman**o** wako.]
• Feel your feet, then your legs. - Ishike akili yako kwenye miguu yako, kisha mapaja yako.  [Ishike akili yako kwenye miguu yako, kisha mapaja yako.]
• Notice your jaw moving, quietly. - Tazama taya yako ikisogea taratibu.  [Tazama taya yako ikisogea taratibu.]
